title: The Technician role has no Deactivate parts, Part Status, tracking switch or Delete Part controls
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as a user on the stock Technician role. Data: QAPL-T1 (active, tracked) and QAPL-I1 (inactive). Default bundles: the Delete-gated controls show to exactly the users who see Delete on the part dialog today (by default Admin, Service Manager and Parts Manager).
custom_steps:
1. Go to /parts/inventory (Active tab) and open the ⋮ actions menu if it is shown.
  2. Switch to the Inactive tab and open the ⋮ actions menu if it is shown.
  3. Back on the Active tab, click the QAPL-T1 row.
  4. If Edit Inventory Part opened, look at Part Status, the tracking switch and the footer.
custom_expected:
1. No "Deactivate parts" entry is offered (or no ⋮ menu is shown at all).
  2. No "Activate parts" entry is offered (or no ⋮ menu is shown at all).
  3. Either no dialog opens (no edit access) or Edit Inventory Part opens for QAPL-T1.
  4. Part Status radios (radio_part_status_active / radio_part_status_inactive) are visible but disabled, "Track quantities and cost of goods" is disabled showing the saved state, and there is no Delete Part button (button_delete_part), matching who saw Delete before.
